reviews.title: Nice, but would like to see some updates
reviews.text:
My husband and I love this and we have only been using this for the past month, but we wish there was a way to indicate how many days of the week you will be shopping/ cooking for. There are sometimes when we only need to cook for 5/7 days and we have to decipher which of the meals required which ingredients for the shopping. I just think it’d be better if we can choose how many days we are cooking for.

Also maybe have more than 1 store option at a time. Also being able to click multiple recipes and being able to regenerate them instead of having to go into each one would be nice.

reviews.title: Good concept, needs work
reviews.text:
I selected simple recipes and excluded a grill for cooking devices. My results had a grill recipe. I shuffled the recipe and it seems the shopping list added the ingredients for the new recipe but it did not seem to remove the ingredients from the previous recipe. It would help if the ingredients and/or quantities had a hyperlink back to the recipe it came from. 

I am hoping future updates have more crock pot and pressure cooker recipes. It sems the recipes are limited as after two shuffles of one recipe it tells me there are no more options.

reviews.title: Charging $10/week is psychotic
reviews.text:
Edit: I just want to say THEY JACKED UP THE PRICE!!!!! All the reviews FROM THIS PAST SUNDAY SAID THE APP COST $7/WEEK AND NOW IT’s $10/Week. FOUL AND DISGUSTING. 

I wanted to use this app, but charging $10/week is psycho and wayyyyy too expensive. And the fact that that’s the only option is such an awful business model. Definitely a man who created this lol. I understand that they need to make money, but I (and I’m sure many many people) would lowk prefer ads with an free experience rather than charging $40/month which is not feasible for majority of people (sorry it’s not argue with the wall). This app is not accessible and it’s screwed up it’s kept behind a paywall. Want a good review? Create an app EVERYONE can use. Such a waste.

reviews.title: save your phone storage & money
reviews.text:
As great as the concept is, the app is deeply flawed and full of AI slop. The images of recipes are so obviously AI, none of the food in the images looks real or edible. On top of that, it’s $10 a week to continue using. If I’m trying to budget for meals, in what world would I want to pay $40 a month for poorly AI-generated recipes? 

Not to mention the bugs— I set a budget and the plan it generated was over the budget. It then told me to increase my budget to $100 for “more premium options”, and my budget was already $100.

In theory, an app designed to work with your budget, consider dietary needs, and even be specific to your grocery store sounds wonderful. But this one is not the answer.

reviews.title: AI Slop - Same Meals Over and Over Again
reviews.text: Don’t waste your time or money. It literally gives you the same “recipes” over and over again. Salmon and sweet potatoes, fried rice, chicken and spinach wrap, salads, and vegetable soup. The option to swap out your meal with a different recipe doesn’t work. Then the instructions are so basic and vague, you if you did follow this your food would end up being so bland. Literally every single recipe says cook according to package instructions add salt and garlic. $9.99 a week is a joke, and it doesn’t even stick to the price parameters you set. Theres 100s of other free apps that does the same exact thing. I would give this negative stars if I could.

reviews.title: Has potential but still a lot of room to improve.
reviews.text:
I like that the app asks for meal preferences, dietary restrictions, and budget. What I feel that could improve:
• the budget only accounts for 1/4 cup of cream, you can’t buy 1/4 cup of cream and so on for things that are usually sold prepackaged. 
•It would be great if the meal plan for the week could reuse ingredients through out the meals to reduce waste and actually stay within budget. 
•It would be cool if it actually used and showed actual prices of the grocery list items from each store.
•Should add a dietary preference of high protein meals. 
•would be great if each individual recipe could be rated by others to see if it’s any good, since these seem to be generated by AI that doesn’t have taste buds. 
So far I don’t think this apps price warrants the weekly price point of $9.99 since it’s not doing much except generating a bunch of recipes with not much logic that you can do elsewhere for free.

reviews.title: Good idea
reviews.text: This is a good idea, but the kinks need to be worked out, especially if there’s no free version. I selected that I was allergic to fish and shellfish, but then it continued to select dishes with these ingredients. I would hit the regenerate button, and many of the same meals would pop up, while a banner across the top says that there will be no repeats. I also think there should be an option to select which meals you are and are not choosing to make for the week so that the grocery list can be updated to reflect this. I was excited about this, but unfortunately canceled the free trial immediately.

reviews.title: Always a week behind
reviews.text:
I do really like this app, but I wish there was an option to change the start of the week to Sunday rather than Monday, because that always puts me a week behind and will always have to go into meal history to find. I do my shopping on Sunday for the upcoming week, but it has Sunday as the last day of the week, so when I do my shopping, that week will be done. 
Would really like an option to change if we choose.

reviews.title: Love so far, but needs more features!
reviews.text: Love this app, has so much potential! I would love to have options to select which meals you want generated for the week (breakfast, lunch, or dinner). Also, would be great if you could add an overall option to switch to generating bi-weekly or monthly meal plans! Some of us don’t want to plan and grocery shop every single week!

reviews.title: Alright
reviews.text: This is definitely an app I’ve been waiting for!!! I will say it does have a few bug that need to be worked on such as the promo codes when referring friends to the app and such. I would also love to be able to choose up to 3 stores in the store section due to the fact some stores may have items for a lower price or better price than the other price. But overall I am loving the vision of what the app could be!!!
